title: Catalogue metadata controlled registry source and output paths

reproductions.test: rejects noncanonical and path-like resource slugs at both manifest and reference boundaries
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: ResourceManifestSchema accepted ../private and other noncanonical slugs.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: both ResourceManifest and ResourceRef enforce lowercase kebab-case slugs.

reproductions.test: retains the discovered resource directory instead of trusting manifest category metadata
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: buildCatalogueFromDirectory returned no mapping from the validated manifest to its actual discovered directory, leaving the registry script to reconstruct a filesystem path from manifest metadata.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: the validated manifest maps to its discovered folder even when its category metadata contains ../outside.
